Import the workflow from the gallery link above, or open a new workflow, click ⋯ → Import from File and pick the attached report-summary-videos.json. Add your Shotstack API key to Make the video and Check the render. You can start a free trial here: Shotstack - The Cloud Video Editing API Add an API key for your AI model to the Claude steps. Claude Opus 5.5 is the model I’ve had the most success with. Fill in Your report: the file name, your company name, your brand colours and who’s watching (the team, the board, clients). Put your file in a reports folder in n8n’s files folder. In Docker, mount a folder from your computer there, for example -v ./n8n-files:/home/node/.n8n-files. On an npm install the folder is .n8n-files in your home folder. Click Execute workflow. A video takes about 15 minutes. What it costs and how long it takes
About 15 minutes: Claude writes the edit in about 4, and the voice and render take about 10

sources.title: Handle text and images replies
sources.text: I am building a scenario in Make.com to handle customer messages received through Facebook Messenger.
taskExcerpts: I am building a scenario in Make.com to handle customer messages received through Facebook Messenger.

spans.text: I am building a scenario in Make.com to handle customer messages received through Facebook Messenger. Customers can send either text messages or images. I use a Router to separate incoming messages into two routes: Text route: Processes text messages. Image route: Detects image messages and downloads the images so they can be used later in the scenario. The problem occurs when a customer sends an image along with a message such as, “I want this product.” Even though the image has already been received and downloaded, the AI agent asks the customer to send the image again. I want the AI agent to recognize that the image has already been received and use the available image to identify the product, rather than asking the customer to resend it. How can I structure my Make.com scenario so that both the text and image routes provide the necessary information to the same AI agent, allowing it to understand the customer’s message and analyze the image when one has been provided?

spans.text: Hydrogen went GA as a framework-agnostic library with the 2026-10 API release — you can now drop Shopify commerce into an existing stack rather than starting from a Hydrogen project.
I’ve been building custom apps (seller attribution, B2B order flows, ERP sync) that sit alongside standard Shopify storefronts.

If you’re writing underscore-prefixed cart attributes for attribution or custom B2B fields, those travel with the order regardless of which storefront renders the cart. I’ve not seen this break in practice when migrating a client from a custom theme to Hydrogen — the attribute was on the order, not the renderer.

What I can help with: - Connecting Google Forms to Google Sheets - Sending automatic Gmail notifications - Organizing simple workflows using Make filters and routers - Setting up basic customer email workflows - Helping test and troubleshoot simple scenarios I have built a practice workflow using Google Forms, Google Sheets, Gmail, and Gemini for customer support and request classification. sources.title: Can n8n be integrated with MirrorFly Instant Messaging Software?
sources.text: I want to check the possibility of integrating MirrorFly with n8n and understand how the platforms could work.
taskExcerpts: I want to check the possibility of integrating MirrorFly with n8n and understand how the platforms could work.

spans.text: I want to check the possibility of integrating MirrorFly with n8n and understand how the platforms could work. MirrorFly, a complete communication software solution that includes instant messaging, one-to-one and group chats, voice and video calls, group calling, and more. Businesses can purchase a complete software package. I am interested in exploring how n8n could connect with MirrorFly to automate workflows and integrate communication features with other business applications. For example, this could include automating notifications, connecting with CRM systems, or triggering workflows based on specific events. Has anyone integrated MirrorFly or a similar communication software solution with n8n using APIs or webhooks? I’d appreciate any suggestions on the feasibility of this integration and the best way to get started.
